issue_body:
# /projects/screenshot-to-primevue — Performance below threshold

**Detected:** 2026-08-11T23:35:13.018Z
**Previous score:** 82 (LCP 4093 ms)
**Current score:** 78 (LCP 4784 ms)

## Problem
The Screenshot → PrimeVue project page scores 78 on Lighthouse performance with an LCP of 4.8 s, which is below the 85-point threshold. The score has now dropped a further 4 points from the prior audit's already-below-threshold 82.

## Likely cause
The three sample screenshot thumbnails (Login form, Analytics dashboard, Pricing page) are loaded eagerly and appear to be unoptimised, high-resolution images. The LCP element is likely the hero drop-zone or one of these thumbnails.

## Suggested fixes
1. Convert sample thumbnails to WebP and serve at display size (≈300 px wide).
2. Add `loading="lazy"` to below-the-fold thumbnail images.
3. Ensure the drop-zone illustration/icon is inlined or preloaded if it is the LCP element.
4. Consider adding an explicit `fetchpriority="high"` hint to the LCP image.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Run Lighthouse (mobile) on https://dliamkin.com/projects/screenshot-to-primevue.
2. Observe performance score of 78 and LCP ≥ 4.5 s.
